<ls>P. III. 3. 92</ls>.
.²1 Fraud, dishonesty; {#nirupaDi viSudDaM vijayate#} <ls>U.</ls> {#arizu hi vijayArTinaH#}

 {#paSyettatsarvaM vinivartate#} <ls>Ms. 8. 165</ls>.

 {#vyavahArAnnivartayet#} <ls>Y. 2. 31</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">89</ls>.

 wheel itself; {#naByeva na upaDIva praDIva#} <ls>Rv. 2. 39. 4</ls>.
